section.p: Sensors are provisioned through the configuration steps. However, once sensor is provisioned, then you can perform the following operations using Sensor API endpoints.

ol.li: Update the sensor data service endpoint.
Disconnect from the ad-hoc connection and reestablish the connection with the primary OtoSense™ REST API service.
Register the sensor with your tenant using the provision sensor request.
Assign the sensor to a motor with the attach motor sensor request.

section.title: Result
section.p: For more information on provisioning, see the OtoSense™ SMS sensor configuration documentation.
